verdict: AMD's revenue grew 34% to $10.3B as Data Center sales rose 39% on AI demand, and net income more than tripled to $1.5B — even after a $109M loss from discontinued operations below the line.

segments.name: Data Center
segments.note: EPYC server processors and Instinct AI accelerators — up 39% as AI data centers kept buying; the segment earned $1,752M of operating profit.

segments.name: Client
segments.note: Ryzen processors for PCs — up 34% on strong demand and continued market-share gains.

segments.name: Gaming
segments.note: Graphics cards and console chips — up 50% YoY on Radeon GPU demand, though down from the prior quarter as semi-custom console revenue faded.

segments.name: Embedded
segments.note: Chips built into cars, industrial gear and communications equipment (the Xilinx business) — up 3% YoY.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Designing the next generations of CPUs, GPUs and AI accelerators — up 36% YoY.

opex.name: Marketing, general & administrative
opex.note: Selling products and running the company.

opex.name: Amortization of acquisition intangibles
opex.note: Writing down the value of technology bought in acquisitions (Xilinx above all) — a bookkeeping charge, not cash.

takeaways.title: Data Center is the engine
takeaways.text: Data Center brought in $5.4B — 52% of all revenue — and $1,752M of segment operating profit, as demand for EPYC server chips and Instinct AI accelerators stayed strong.

takeaways.title: Gross margin widened
takeaways.text: Gross margin reached 54%, up from 51% a year ago, as high-value data-center products became a bigger share of the mix.

takeaways.title: Cash piled up
takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $2,082M — 20% of revenue — taking cash and short-term investments to $10.6B against just $3.2B of debt.

oneTimers: A $109M loss from discontinued operations sits below the continuing-operations line; profit from continuing operations was $1,620M.
Stock-based compensation was $486M inside the expense lines; on AMD's non-GAAP view (which excludes it and acquisition amortization), net income was $2,519M instead of $1,511M.
otherDetail: Other income of $358M plus $1M of equity income, less $36M of interest expense and a $109M loss from discontinued operations — a net +$214M.
